interface.title: DBREF-SIFTS
interface.stage_of_work: Annotating and preparing deposited or modelled structures: linking PDB chains to reference protein sequences before analysis or deposition
interface.what_it_is_for: Given one or more PDB IDs, it maps each chain to UniProt, either from curated SIFTS or by automated sequence search and alignment, and outputs the result as wwPDB DBREF records with a per-chain table of identity, coverage and warnings.

data.note: The input box is prefilled with 6tlj and runs at page load. The explorer also entered 3A1Y, 2RH1, 9ZZZ and 1CRN. Data comes live from the PDBe and UniProt APIs, called on the server. During the explorer's session the UniProt calls failed: details rows had Reviewed='?', empty Protein/Organism columns and a 'not found in UniProtKB (obsolete or demerged?)' warning, and every Automated run returned no match. This was a temporary outage, not a property of the deployment: in the replay, Automated mode mapped 3A1Y with Swiss-Prot review status filled in.

features.name: Batch identifier entry with validation and per-entry result sections
features.general: Paste a list of IDs into one box; malformed IDs are rejected up front; each valid ID gets its own result block, and a combined-export button appears when there are several
features.specific: Type space- or comma-separated PDB IDs in 'PDB ID(s)'; IDs not matching 4 characters starting with a digit block the run; each entry gets a header, status banner, DBREF block, its own download and a Mapping details section; 'Download all N entries as one file' appears above the sections and saves dbref_combined (.txt in Fixed columns, .tsv in Tab-delimited)
steps: type one or more PDB IDs separated by spaces or commas
press Enter to run
if an ID is malformed, read the red error and fix the list
scroll through the per-entry sections
press 'Download all N entries as one file' to get dbref_combined

features.name: Mapping method switch with dependent threshold controls and per-entity diagnostics
features.general: Choose between a curated database lookup and a computed alignment; the threshold controls are enabled only in the computed mode, which reports progress and gives a reason for each item it cannot match
features.specific: Methods radio Curated (SIFTS) / Automated (PDBe-SIFTS); the 'Minimum identity to accept' slider (50–100, default 90) is greyed out in Curated mode; 'SwissProt only' limits the UniProtKB search to reviewed entries; progress banners ('Listing protein entities…', 'Aligning entity N against 1 candidate(s)…'); unmatched entries show a red 'No UniProt mapping could be established' banner with a per-entity reason
steps: pick Curated or Automated in the Methods radio
in Automated, set the minimum identity slider and SwissProt only
watch the progress banners while entities are searched and aligned
read the mapped records (source 'auto'), or the per-entity reasons for chains that did not map

features.name: Segment merge option for contiguous stretches
features.general: Optionally join pieces of one chain that continue directly into each other in both the structure and the reference sequence, so they become a single record; pieces separated by an insertion stay separate
features.specific: The Merge segments checkbox joins DBREF segments only where they run on directly in both PDB and UniProt numbering (README, merge_adjacent()); the tooltip's 'broken by an insertion or deletion' wording overstates this. 2RH1's ADRB2 segments are split by the T4 lysozyme insert, so they are correctly left unmerged
steps: check Merge segments
compare the DBREF lines and details rows for chains with several segments
uncheck to go back to per-segment records
